English: Report a problem in your area and track whether it gets fixed.
tw draft: Ka ɔhaw a ɛwɔ wo mpɔtam hɔ ho amanneɛ, na hwɛ sɛ wɔasiesie no.
Mpɔtam (district) anaa kurow panin (sɛ wopɛ a)

English: Avoid faces and house numbers. You can hide them after you take the photo.
tw draft: Nfa nnipa anim anaa ofie nɔma nka ho. Sɛ wɔwɔ foto no mu a, wubetumi ahintaw wɔn akyiri yi.

English: Tap the map to mark the spot, or use your location.
tw draft: Mia map no so de kyerɛ beae no, anaa fa w’ankasa wo beae.

English: Your device cannot share its location. Tap the map instead.
tw draft: Wo fon no ntumi nkyɛ ne beae. Mia map no so.

English: Location is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or tap the map.
tw draft: Wɔasi beae no kwan. Ma kwan wɔ wo browser no mu, anaa mia map no so.
Rehwehwɛ amanneɛ a ɛte sɛ eyi…

English: Choose the problem and add a photo.
tw draft: Paw ɔhaw no na fa foto ka ho.

English: Choose the area and mark the spot on the map.
tw draft: Paw mpɔtam no na kyerɛ beae no wɔ map no so.

English: Choose a problem, an area, a photo, and mark the spot.
tw draft: Paw ɔhaw, mpɔtam, foto, na kyerɛ beae no.

English: The report was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
tw draft: Wɔansoma amanneɛ no. Hwɛ wo intanɛt (connection) na san sɔ hwɛ.

English: Confirming an existing report makes it harder to ignore.
tw draft: Sɛ wosi amanneɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw so dua a, ɛma ɛyɛ den sɛ obi bɛpow.
Wɔasi so dua. Meda wo ase.

English: Ask neighbors to confirm it. Three confirmations mark it as verified.
tw draft: Bisa wo mpɔtamfo sɛ wɔnsi so dua. Sɛ nnipa mmiɛnsa si so dua a, wɔhu sɛ ɛyɛ nokware.
Wɔde akɔma adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ ho asɛdeɛ

English: Reopened: neighbours say it is not fixed
tw draft: Wɔabue bio: mpɔtamfo no se wɔnsiesie

English: The office gave an expected fix date
tw draft: Adwumayɛbea no ama da a wɔbɛsiesie

English: The office says this is not its responsibility
tw draft: Adwumayɛbea no se ɛnyɛ wɔn asɛdeɛ

Notes: SAFETY WORDING: please check with extra care

English: Call before you report. Calls to 112 are free.
tw draft: Frɛ ansa na woaka amanneɛ. Frɛ 112 yɛ kwa.

English: CivicPulse is not an emergency service. Nobody here sees reports the moment they are sent, so a report cannot bring help for someone in danger.
tw draft: CivicPulse nyɛ ntɛm mmoa adwuma. Obiara nhu amanneɛ no bere koro a wɔsoma, enti amanneɛ ntumi mma mmoa nkɔ obi a ɔwɔ asiane mu nkyɛn.
Notes: SAFETY WORDING: please check with extra care

English: Hide faces, number plates or house numbers
tw draft: Fa nnipa anim, kar nɔma anaa ofie nɔma hintaw
Fa nsɛm a ɛyɛ kokoam hintaw

English: Drag a box over anything that identifies a person: faces, number plates, house numbers. It is covered with a coarse mosaic on this phone, before anything is sent.
tw draft: Twetwe adaka fa biribiara a ɛkyerɛ onipa so: anim, kar nɔma, ofie nɔma. Wɔde mosaic bɛkata so wɔ fon yi so ansa na wɔresoma biribiara.
Yi adaka a etwa to no

English: That box was too small. Drag a bigger one.
tw draft: Adaka no sua dodo. Twetwe kɛse.

English: Report a problem in under a minute, even without signal. Neighbors confirm it, the responsible office is named, and every day it stays open is on the record.
tw draft: Ka ɔhaw ho amanneɛ wɔ simma baako mu, sɛ network nni hɔ mpo. Mpɔtamfo si so dua, wɔfrɛ adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ ho asɛdeɛ no din, na da biara a ɛda hɔ no wɔkyerɛw si.
Ɛyɛ adwuma a network nni hɔ
Wɔmmɔ beae pɛpɛɛpɛ no mma obiara

English: A photo and the exact spot. Saved on your phone first, so weak signal never loses it.
tw draft: Foto ne beae pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wɔsie wɔ wo fon so kane, enti network a ɛyɛ mmerɛ nhwere.

English: Three confirmations verify the problem and make it hard to ignore.
tw draft: Sɛ nnipa mmiɛnsa si so dua a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔhaw no wɔ hɔ, na ɛyɛ den sɛ obi bɛpow.

English: Moderators escalate to whoever is responsible. Every step stays on the record.
tw draft: Moderators de kɔma obi a ɔwɔ ho asɛdeɛ. Anamɔn biara wɔkyerɛw si.
